info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Creditcard Applications Submit-v3-spec
info.description: The Credit Card Application Submission API allows users to efficiently submit multiple credit card applications in a single batch. This service supports financial institutions and application processors in streamlining their application intake processes. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their customer experience through quick and consolidated submissions. Typical consumers include banks, financial platforms, and credit service providers looking to optimize their application workflows.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to submit a new application by providing the necessary details. Ensure that all required fields are filled in correctly to process the application successfully.

requestBody.description: Submits a new application. This request body should contain the necessary details for creating a new application instance, formatted as JSON.

200.description: The request was successfully processed and the application data is returned.
